description.intro: The Hummel Betis Line Up jacket is part of the official presentation collection of Real Betis Balopí for the 2026-2027 season. Designed to support the team before games and on the move, it combines an exclusive design with the comfort necessary for everyday life.
key_benefits: Official Real Betis design: Presentation jacket for the 2026 2027 season.
Exclusive graphic: Front print inspired by the green and white identity that provides a modern and distinctive style.
Light protection: Its technical fabric offers comfort and light warmth for any time of the day.
Comfortable fit: Full zipper, high collar and elastic cuffs for greater protection and comfort.
